contract: Every default native installer artifact must have an install, verify, upgrade-or-reinstall, and uninstall smoke path before release upload, and its installed entrypoint must consume packaged runtime resources.

lifecycle.verify: installed bin/row.exe --version and platforms --json consume the packaged platform catalog; bin/row-gui.exe exists on x64/ARM64
lifecycle.upgrade: rerun the same setup.exe silently over the installed copy, then rerun bin/row.exe --version and platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: run generated unins*.exe silently and verify row.exe and row-gui.exe are removed

lifecycle.verify: installed Program Files row.exe --version and platforms --json consume the packaged platform catalog; row-gui.exe exists on x64/ARM64
lifecycle.upgrade: msiexec /i <artifact> /qn /norestart over the installed product, then rerun row.exe --version and platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: msiexec /x <artifact> /qn /norestart and verify row.exe and row-gui.exe are removed

lifecycle.install: hdiutil attach read-only DMG and copy Remote Ops Workspace.app into a smoke Applications directory
lifecycle.verify: codesign --verify --deep --strict on the copied app bundle and run its executable with platforms --json to consume the packaged platform catalog
lifecycle.upgrade: replace the copied app bundle from the mounted DMG, reverify its signature, and rerun its executable with platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: remove the copied app bundle and detach the DMG

lifecycle.verify: installed /Applications/Remote Ops Workspace.app exists, passes codesign verification, and its executable runs platforms --json against the packaged platform catalog
lifecycle.upgrade: sudo installer -pkg <artifact> -target / over the installed package, reverify its signature, and rerun its executable with platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: remove /Applications/Remote Ops Workspace.app and forget the package receipt

lifecycle.verify: /usr/bin/row --version and platforms --json consume the packaged platform catalog
lifecycle.upgrade: sudo -n dpkg -i <artifact> over the installed package, then rerun /usr/bin/row --version and platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: sudo -n dpkg -r remote-ops-workspace and verify /usr/bin/row is removed

lifecycle.install: sudo -n rpm -Uvh --nodeps --replacepkgs <artifact> on Ubuntu CI runners
lifecycle.verify: /usr/bin/row --version and platforms --json consume the packaged platform catalog
lifecycle.upgrade: sudo -n rpm -Uvh --nodeps --replacepkgs <artifact> over the installed package on Ubuntu CI runners, then rerun /usr/bin/row --version and platforms --json
lifecycle.uninstall: sudo -n rpm -e --nodeps remote-ops-workspace and verify /usr/bin/row is removed

lifecycle.verify: APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 row.AppImage --version and platforms --json consume the packaged platform catalog
lifecycle.upgrade: overwrite the staged AppImage with the same artifact and rerun --version and platforms --json
